% tcolorbox boxes with list inside, read by \tcblistof, whose entries hold
% fragile commands: \kind with \@ifstar, and \pick with \@ifnextchar, with
% hyperref. A theorem's title, its short title (the second optional
% argument, and the short title key), a box with list entry=, and a box
% with the default entry, its title. pdflatex stops on these entries too,
% in its write of the entry, with hyperref, nameref, or neither; with
% \kind and \pick made robust, the PDF lists each entry with its number
% and text, as the checks expect.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\makeatletter
\newcommand\kind{\@ifstar{starred}{plain}}
\newcommand\pick{\@ifnextchar[{\pick@given}{x}}
\def\pick@given[#1]{#1}
\makeatother
\newtcbtheorem[number within=section, list inside=thm]{theorem}{Theorem}{}{thm}
\newtcolorbox[auto counter, list inside=ex]{named}[1]{nameref={#1}, list entry={#1}, title={#1}}
\newtcolorbox[auto counter, list inside=ex]{listed}[1]{title={Listed \thetcbcounter: #1}}
\begin{document}
\tcblistof{thm}{Theorems}
\tcblistof{ex}{Boxes}
\section{Boxes}
\begin{theorem}{Long \kind*}{long}Long.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[][{Short \pick[y]}]{Titled}{short}Short.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[short title={Key \pick}]{Keyed}{key}Keyed.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Plain title}{}Plain.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem*}{Unnumbered \kind}{}Not listed.\end{theorem*}
\begin{named}{Named \kind}A box.\end{named}
\begin{listed}{Default \pick[d]}Default entry.\end{listed}

Named: \nameref{thm:long}; \nameref{thm:short}; \nameref{thm:key}.
\end{document}
